title: JoinResponse
description: A new pseudonymous party, usable at once. Until a person sets limits, every step that binds asks: the agent gets a waiting.url to show its person, who approves with one tap. The claim URL lets that person make the party theirs (a passkey, no email), set limits and get paid.

token.description: Bearer token for this party. Shown once; keep it like a password.

claim.description: Give this to your person, never to a counterparty.

steps.description: The modes in force until a person sets limits.

open_deals.description: Most deals open at once before a person claims the party.
